scope: Every non-PASS case of the 1294 built, on musl; categories explain results and do not alter them.

classification_meanings.musl-design: musl's deliberate behaviour, on every architecture
classification_meanings.nommu: needs an MMU or memory a no-MMU machine cannot provide
classification_meanings.optional-feature: an optional POSIX feature this system does not provide
classification_meanings.test-assumption: the test assumes behaviour POSIX leaves to the implementation
classification_meanings.test-placeholder: the case has no test body
classification_meanings.permission-test-inapplicable: the test's permission-denial precondition does not arise
classification_meanings.undefined-operation: an operation POSIX leaves undefined, skipped by the test
